business_summary.text: Sirca Paints India Ltd. is one of India's leading premium wood coatings and surface solutions companies, offering a diverse portfolio of brands including 'Sirca', 'Unico', 'Oikos', 'Wembley', and 'Welcome' through an extensive pan-India distribution network.

call_points.text: Target double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA, margin recovery expected as localisation scales
New Wembley facility fully operational, consolidating production lines for efficiency
Margin discipline held through volatility with calibrated pricing and sourcing optimisation
Premiumization and renovation demand remain intact, OEM business aided by furniture formalisation

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 1.50 Per Share
Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 2 Per Share
Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 1.50 Per Share

exceptions: fine or penalty: Indian Custome Department (Late Fine)

penalties.impact: To the extent of fine amount

guidance.statement: Target double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA
Expect margin recovery as localization and premium mix scale

operating_notes.text: 95% of products previously imported from Italy are now produced in India
Wembley and Welcome contributed ₹120.5 Cr in FY26, with Wembley at ₹74 Cr and Welcome at ₹46.5 Cr
80% of revenue comes from North India; focus on expanding West and South in FY27
Acrylic coatings sustained strong traction in Q1, the fastest-growing premium wood-coatings segment
Formula transfer for acrylic and polyester systems completed and commercial production commenced in Q1FY27
Sirca Parivaar Pro app has 25,000+ registered contractors with average daily users of 20,000+

timeline.summary: Sirca Paints FY26 revenue grew 31.79% YoY to ₹492.48 Cr; guided FY27 revenue growth at 25-30% with EBITDA margin of 19-21%.

watchlist.response: Increased due to Wembley/Welcome acquisition transition; expected to improve as transition completes and inventory of imported products is consumed.
watchlist.text: Working capital is almost twice as high as peers like Asian Paints
